ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The image is a "schematic map of the location of Yonaguni Island." The figure marks the locations of mainland China, Taiwan Island of China, Yonaguni Island, the Diaoyu Islands, Ishigaki Island, Miyako Island, Okinawa, etc., and uses arrows and distances to show that Yonaguni Island is about 110 kilometers from the Taiwan region, about 150 kilometers from the Diaoyu Islands, and about 500 kilometers from Okinawa; in the lower right corner there is also a small schematic map of the relative locations of Japan and Tokyo, Taipei, and Yonaguni Island. This shows that the question indeed comes from the background of a report about the location of Yonaguni Island. The question stem asks "if the report says that on that day the Sun shines directly on a certain place," and the key is "direct sunlight." When the Sun shines directly on a certain place, at noon that day the Sun is located at the zenith at that place, and the noon solar altitude is 90°. The maximum value of solar altitude does not exceed 90°, so this day is the day with the greatest solar altitude at that place in the year.
